title: Module 2: Accountability and Liability
description: Address the responsibility gap by distributing accountability across developer, deployer, operator, and user; recognize when human-in-the-loop is structural fig leaf; and apply engineering practices (audit trails, model cards, versioning, incident response) that make accountability real.
learning_objectives: Explain the responsibility gap and why it cannot be closed by attributing responsibility to the AI system itself.
Distribute accountability across four roles (developer, deployer, operator, user) with role-specific failure ownership.
Distinguish meaningful human oversight from rubber-stamping using the capacity-time-authority-information test.
Identify five engineering practices (audit trails, model cards, versioning, incident response, whistleblower channels) that operationalize accountability.
